title: T-Rex Arms and Stumpy Thighs: How Remco Evenepoel Became ‘The Aero Bullet’
content:
Evenepoel has dominated time trialing for years, and he's poised to win a historic fourth world title in Montréal this weekend. His aero secret lies in his pint-sized proportions.

Read the full article at T-Rex Arms and Stumpy Thighs: How Remco Evenepoel Became ‘The Aero Bullet’ on Velo.
author: Jim Cotton
